data.narrative:
Swarmbotics AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Stephen Houghton and Drew Watson that has raised $17.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers spanning both Series A and Seed rounds, with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The peer set includes publicly traded defense firms and a broader ecosystem of private frontier-tech companies in autonomous systems and AI-enabled defense.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier, yielding $43M. Peer-median analysis across the five identified comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, reflecting the sector's current capital intensity and the wide dispersion in exit outcomes across the peer group ($125M to $4.0B).

The two methods produce material divergence, suggesting a triangulated range of $37M (floor) to $1.1B (ceiling), with a median of $522M. The low-end reflects stage-based mechanistic progression; the high-end reflects peer median positioning. Key uncertainties include the company's proprietary technical differentiation relative to the peer cohort, revenue traction and customer concentration in the defense end-market, and the impact of regulatory and export control regimes on valuation multiples in this sector.
